title: RustSec Remediation Plan (Epic 4)
summary: Plan to remediate or formally risk-accept two blocking RustSec advisories before the Epic 4 release candidate GO decision.
notes: Type set by MANIFEST_TYPE=DOC. Open security work recorded verbatim: RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (rsa 0.9.10, Marvin timing side-channel; path rsa -> sqlx-mysql -> sqlx -> workspace crates; no fixed upgrade available) and RUSTSEC-2025-0111 (tokio-tar 0.3.1, PAX header parsing file smuggling; path tokio-tar -> testcontainers -> testcontainers-modules; no fixed upgrade available). Disposition: both UNRESOLVED, mitigated by exception governance — `make audit` and CI run `cargo audit --ignore RUSTSEC-2023-0071 --ignore RUSTSEC-2025-0111`; exception owner Platform Security (Milestone 7); review/expiry target 2026-09-30. Completed hardening: testcontainers-modules moved to dev-dependencies, MySQL repo module gated on `storage-mysql`, sqlx default features disabled. cargo audit still reports both advisories. Open action items remain (impact-analysis issues, audit.toml entries, re-run audit evidence).
